action_resume_retry_count: "-1"    # infinite retries if host is down
file_create_mode: "0644" # Set the access permissions for the state file
queue_filename: "fwdRule1"       # unique name prefix for spool files
queue_maxdiskspace: "1g"         # 1gb space limit (use as much as possible)
queue_saveonshutdown: "on"       # save messages to disk on shutdown
state_file: "imjournal.state") # File to store the position in the journal
sys_sock_use: "off") # Turn off message reception via local log socket;
use_pid: "system" # PID nummber is retrieved as the ID of the process the journal entry originates from
